Livermore's budget as bars

Where the money comes from and where it goes, each a list of bars on one scale, largest first, opening in place into the parts the budget prints. Drawn from the FY 2026-27 adopted budget.

Each side is a list of bars, largest first, every bar on the one scale the page's largest bar sets. Click a bar that opens to see its parts under it, indented; click it again to close it. Shift-click opens a bar its other way where the budget prints one. A bar marked inferred is a figure the city prints only as a difference; one with a leading minus is printed as a reduction and counts against its parent. Every figure is a sum of cells the city printed, and the table below lists each with the page it was read from. A share marked ◇ is ours: one bar as a percentage of its side.

The column drawn: fy2027-adopted.json.

  • No link pairs a transfer's two legs; transfers out exceed transfers in by $50,762,251, the transfers to the Capital Improvement Program.
  • Internal Service charges are billed between city departments, so they are outside the external headline.
  • The city's own book prints two different figures for Internal Service Funds expenditure, $250,000 apart; this chart draws the one on pp.66-67.
  • Beginning and ending working capital are stocks, not flows, so the chart carries no link for them.
  • Permanent Funds are a seventh fund type, and this schedule prints no column for them.
  • A fund's constraint tier is our reading of the Description of Funds narrative, not a figure the city printed.
  • Budget Book pp.127-140 are published twice on this site: the chart draws their adopted columns one year at a time, and the Over time page prints all four.
  • Every cell of the citywide chart opens into the finer schedules that print it, and they sum back to it to the cent.
  • 4 fund groups' money pp.66-67 print that no fund's own page carries, drawn on a node of the group's own. A fund of such a group is drawn with what it takes in and spends, so its in and out differ by its own change in balance.

Every page's caveats are collected on the caveats page.
